text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Digital, look! I made a brand new paper
fan for
today's idol fest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohmygoooosh! Falco made this
herseeeelf!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the love exuding from every
fold! It's
sooo wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So you can tell? I really
wanted to
make it speak for me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I so get it! The want for your oshis to know you've come to cheer them on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Plus, since they're starring in
such an
amazing event, I want everyone
performing to do
their best today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I get so much energy and courage from their concerts... So today, I'm going to give them energy with my best cheers!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Falco, you're so precious!
Oof! Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Digital, are you in pain?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine! Your preciousness cleansed
my
body, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm glad it's nothing serious! I was
worried you
might have to cancel going.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm fit as a fiddle! I've overcome many an
obstacle
to see my lovely Umadols!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's so you! All right then, let's
get going!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I come to this racecourse all the time,
but it feels
different today. I wonder if
I'll ever be in this
event someday...

text_block_list.name: Falco & Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh my gooooosh!
WOOO!
AAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Falco & Digital
text_block_list.text:
Shout it to the world! L, O, V, E!
Love is
the waaay!

text_block_list.name: Falco & Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Yeah, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to go back to reality just
yet! Hey,
why don't we meet up at the
dorm later for round
two?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You mean it's okay if I hang out with
you?! Well,
I-I-I do have their past
concerts on DVD, so we
could watch
those!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! ♪ We can wave our
lightsticks like
crazy! ☆ This fest isn't
over yet!
